title: Draft
description: The current draft class and its ordering. Prospects are just Player objects with teamId=null and no contract. Drafting a prospect = set its teamId, give it a rookie contract, move it out of draft.prospects and into league.players, then log the pick here.

completed.description: true once every pick has been made for this class.

prospects.description: Undrafted players available in this class. Each item conforms to player.schema.json (teamId null, contract null).

order.description: Pick order, usually reverse standings. Fill teamId for each slot; set playerId once the pick is made.

teamId.description: Team that owns this pick (may differ from natural order due to trades).

playerId.description: Prospect selected with this pick, or null if not yet made.
